items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: we met them in this International House of Jazz, you see. So we just had one big ball, you know.

ctx.x: How's this rail holding on? Five minutes. Um, let's see, Moose, maybe we should get on to Vienna now, huh? What happened? How'd you go to Vienna?

Um, this, uh, this thing I have a hard time explaining to most of my friends. See, right off the bat, you have to say it was a communist festival, you see. And, uh, of course the thing was dominated by communists. They invited the communists from the United States and all over the world. But, since this, uh, festival was given in a free country, see, Austria being a free country, this festival was given in Vienna, Austria. You see, so that, uh, we figured that as representatives of the free world, we should take…
Well, did you cut Louis or did he cut you?
